privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how realestates4u collects, uses and protects the information you share with us when you visit this website or contact us about a venture or resale plot.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you enquire about a venture through the Call button, WhatsApp, or any contact form on this site, we collect the information you choose to share — typically your name, phone number, and the details of your enquiry. We do not require you to create an account or share any information simply to browse the site.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: Enquiry details are used only to respond to you about the venture or plot you asked about — for example, to call you back, share a brochure, or arrange a site visit. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: WhatsApp and phone enquiries
sections.body: When you use the WhatsApp or Call buttons on this site, you are taken to WhatsApp or your phone's dialer directly; those conversations are subject to WhatsApp's own privacy policy, not this one.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This site does not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising scripts. If basic visit analytics are added in future (to understand which pages are useful), this policy will be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Enquiry details are kept only as long as needed to follow up with you about the venture or plot you asked about, and are not used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or want any information you've shared removed, contact us using the phone number or WhatsApp link in the site header, or by email if one is listed there.
